title: Add Interaction Specification Layer in DECIDE Phase
summary: Adds Interaction Specifications as a DECIDE-phase artifact at docs/interaction-specs.md, written after scenarios and derived from Product Discovery's stakeholder models, specifying how each stakeholder works with the system at the workflow level — more concrete than scenarios, more stable than implementation details, organized by stakeholder with Super-Objective, Task, and Interaction mechanics fields. The derivation method from stakeholder model to task decomposition is left as an open design problem that evolves through use; the artifact should stay thin, per Invariant 4.
mechanism: interaction-specs.md: per-stakeholder task decompositions (Super-Objective, Task, Interaction mechanics) derived from Product Discovery's stakeholder models

links.note: Interaction Specifications create the Playable Surface that the Play phase (ADR-038) requires; without them, play has nothing structured to discover deviations from.
